notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT + NEW TRAILER!
notes.notes:
BIG NEWS! A Musical Story has a release date! It's launching for PC and Mac on Steam (and other storefronts) on 4th March, priced $14.99, and with a 10% launch discount for a limited time. If you haven't already, be sure to add the game to your wishlist so you receive a notification as soon as it's available

To celebrate the announcement, we've released a BRAND NEW TRAILER:
[previewyoutube=J9WSIlZ0iJ0;full][/previewyoutube]

A Digital Deluxe Edition will also be available on 4th March, and will include the full game, official soundtrack featuring 26 original songs, digital artbook and six wallpapers. It'll be priced $23.96 and will also have a launch discount. Here's a sample of some pages from the artbook, which includes both in-game and unused imagery: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032512/33f065503b2ca0d9adb0abb1296e6c95a4d2140a.png

Thanks to everyone for the support and we can't wait for you all to experience A Musical Story!

Matt | Digerati
